systems.system: campagne nationale de rattrapage de l'enregistrement des naissances (deuxième édition)
systems.country_label: campagne nationale de rattrapage de l'enregistrement des naissances
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Administration territoriale (MATGLAC), direction de l'administration territoriale et des frontières, with OIF support
systems.tiers: launched 2026-07-31 at Agbandi, Blitta 2 commune; 6,461 children targeted (OIF says nearly 7,400 across 25 communes) through supplementary judgments and birth acts; first edition 5,000 children

note: A late-registration catch-up campaign through supplementary judgments: outreach, not an office registering digitally. The OIF lists 'digitalisation of services' among its support without naming a system; the prefect says many rural children remain without a birth act.
